items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And we went from there... From the Cotton Club, we went to the Cotton Club in Cincinnati, and we stayed there for a while -- six months, I think. Then Gay decided he wanted to come back to Milwaukee.

ctx.x: Anyway, he didn't make it. He wasn't that great a bass player in the first place. I guess I shouldn't really mention him. But he was there.

And we went from there... From the Cotton Club, we went to the Cotton Club in Cincinnati, and we stayed there for a while -- six months, I think. Then Gay decided he wanted to come back to Milwaukee. Now, what he wanted to come back to Milwaukee for, I don't know, because he didn't have no job there, and I know when I go back to Milwaukee ain't nothin' happenin' but that WPA band, and I ain't gonna be in that motherfucker no more. I said, "That's it."
You mean they never worked, the WPA band?
